title_en: Fall 2026 Initial Safety and Environment Training Schedule for New Graduate Students and Researchers
summary: New graduate students for Fall 2026 and newly appointed researchers who are subject to the initial safety and environment training (신규교육) need to register for and complete one in-person session. Registration is through the SAFE system between 3 August and 24 August 2026; sessions 1 to 4 run from 19 to 24 August 2026, and a separate Class for International Participants (외국인반) runs on 11 September 2026. Sessions are held in Building 28, Room 101 (Gwanak Campus) or Building 4, Room 121 (Yeongeon Campus).
applies_to: Fall 2026 new graduate students and newly appointed researchers who are confirmed as subjects of the initial safety and environment training (신규교육), i.e. who have not already completed it. Training subjects need to register for, change if needed, and complete only one of sessions 1 to 4; a separate Class for International Participants (외국인반) is also offered. Those who previously completed the initial training and continue research in the same field without a gap, with only their status changing, are not treated as initial training subjects.

dates.what: Training and application period (training subjects are confirmed and register for a session during this period)
Session 4, Yeongeon Campus, College of Medicine Woobong Hall, Building 4, Room 121
Class for International Participants (외국인반), Gwanak Campus, Building 28, Room 101
For returning students who cannot be found in SAFE: days with remaining seats, when walk-in attendance may be possible, are expected to be known around this time
For returning students who attend on site without being found in SAFE: completion is processed after this time
dates.when: After March (as stated in the notice)

conditions: Training subjects need to complete only one of sessions 1 to 4; the Class for International Participants is separate from this count.
All sessions are in person (offline) only.
Newly appointed researchers cannot access SAFE until their tuition payment is completed and confirmed; only after payment are they registered at Seoul National University.
Returning students may or may not be searchable in SAFE depending on the system; they can be found only after their university registration is completed.

Returning students who cannot be found in SAFE may attend on site on a day with remaining seats and have completion processed after March; the notice's sentence on the alternative option is cut off and incomplete.

If you created an external researcher account before registering as a graduate student or researcher, an account conflict may block SAFE access or cause endless loading; the Safety Office must suspend the external account before you can log in.
Access may fail for several of these reasons at once, so solving one problem may not restore access.

If you previously completed the initial training and continue research in the same field without a gap, with only your status changing, you do not need the initial training again and should keep taking the regular training (정기교육).

Some offices may require an initial safety and environment training certificate as a condition for the thesis qualifying exam (논자시); check this with your college's qualifying exam office, and if needed request by email to be added manually to the initial training.
steps: Make sure your university registration is complete (newly appointed researchers: pay tuition and wait for it to be confirmed) so that you can access the SAFE system.
Log in to the SAFE system and register for one of sessions 1 to 4, or the Class for International Participants (외국인반), between 3 and 24 August 2026; change your session in SAFE if needed.

Attend your chosen session in person from 09:00 to 17:50: sessions 1–3 and the Class for International Participants at Gwanak Campus, College of Natural Sciences lecture room, Building 28, Room 101; session 4 at Yeongeon Campus, College of Medicine Woobong Hall, Building 4, Room 121.
If you cannot log in because of an old external researcher account, email the contact address given in the original notice with your name and contact details so the external account can be suspended.

If you need an initial training certificate for the thesis qualifying exam despite not being listed as a subject, confirm with your college's qualifying exam office and, if needed, email the contact address in the original notice to be added manually.
translation:
Fall 2026 Safety and Environment Training (Initial Training, 신규교육) Schedule for New Graduate Students and Newly Appointed Researchers

1. Training dates, times and venues
[Session 1] Wednesday 19 August 2026, 09:00–17:50, [Gwanak Campus] College of Natural Sciences lecture room (Building 28, Room 101)
[Session 2] Thursday 20 August 2026, 09:00–17:50, [Gwanak Campus] College of Natural Sciences lecture room (Building 28, Room 101)
[Session 3] Friday 21 August 2026, 09:00–17:50, [Gwanak Campus] College of Natural Sciences lecture room (Building 28, Room 101)
[Session 4] Monday 24 August 2026, 09:00–17:50, [Yeongeon Campus] College of Medicine Woobong Hall (Yeongeon Building 4, Room 121)
[Class for International Participants (외국인반)] Friday 11 September 2026, 09:00–17:50, [Gwanak Campus] College of Natural Sciences lecture room (Building 28, Room 101)

2. Training method: offline (in-person training)

3. Notes
- Training subjects need to register for, change and complete only one session among sessions 1 to 4, excluding the Class for International Participants.
- The period for confirming training subjects and registering for training is Monday 3 August to Monday 24 August 2026.

4. Inquiries: by email (the address is given in the original notice).

※ Additional information (regarding SAFE system login and registration errors)

1. Newly appointed researchers who have not paid tuition: you can access SAFE only after tuition payment is completed and confirmed. You are registered at Seoul National University only after payment.

2. Returning students: depending on the system, access is possible in some cases and not in others, so it is not easy to check. (Even at the Safety Office, you can be viewed and searched in SAFE only after your registration at the university is completed.) If you cannot be found, you may visit on site on a day when seats remain (expected to be known around mid-August), attend, and have completion processed after March, or the [sentence is cut off in the original notice] scheduled to take place after March.

3. Existing external researcher account: if you created an account as an external researcher before registering as a master's/doctoral student or researcher, an account conflict may prevent access to SAFE or cause endless loading. In this case you can log in only after the Safety Office suspends the external account, so if you provide your personal information such as your name and contact details, it will be checked and suspended.

4. A combination of the above causes: even if one problem is resolved, access may still fail for another reason.

5. Previous completion of the initial training: if you continue research in the same field without any gap and only your status changes, you do not need to take the initial training again and only need to keep taking the regular training (정기교육), so you are not listed as an initial training subject. However, we understand that the relevant offices require submission of an initial safety and environment training certificate as a condition for taking the thesis qualifying exam (논자시); as far as we know, the Safety Office has never requested this or held any discussion about it. You need to confirm this with the qualifying exam office of your college, and if necessary, if you request it by email, you will be added manually.
